title: Okuwuubaala mu Mpewo
intro: Teebereza ekifo ekitalabika n’ebirabibwa mwe byakwataganye, era n’oyimirira mu maaso g’ekifaananyi ekiri wakati mu bwakabaka obutafaananako bulala bwonna. Omwoyo guno gulina okumanya okutali kwa bulijjo, nga guduumira amaanyi abalala ge baali basobola okulowoozaako. Naye, n’abasinga amaanyi basobola okutoowazibwa ekitonde ekitono, era amazima gayinza okusigala nga gakwekeddwa okutuusa ekiseera ekigere. Ani ffiga ono ng’omusika gwe guwulikika okuyita mu mirembe?
clues: Naweebwa obwakabaka nga tewali muntu yenna oluvannyuma lwange bwe yandibadde nabwo.
Nasikira okumanya n’amagezi okuva ku muzadde omwagalwa.
Empewo yali wansi w’ekiragiro kyange, ng’etambula ku kiragiro kyange yonna gye nnali njagala.
Nnali nsobola okutegeera enjogera y’ebinyonyi, era byaweerezanga mu ggye lyange.
Nafuna amawulire okuva mu kanyonyi akatono agakwata ku nnaabagereka eyali asinza enjuba.
Okufa kwange kwasigala nga kwekwese okutuusa ekitonde ky’ensi lwe kyalya omuggo gwange, era awo lwokka amajinni we baategeera nti tebamanyi bitalabika.

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Okufa kwe kwakwekebwa amajinni okutuusa omuggo gwe lwe gwaliibwa
Yalokoka okuva mu muliro ku kiragiro kya Allah
Yawonyezebwa okuva ku nnyanja ekika kya whale

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
